items.title: Common AI Applications (e.g., voice assistants, chatbots, image recognition)

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Common AI Applications (e.g., voice assistants, chatbots, image recognition) under 8.1 as printed (PDF 108, printed 104).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence is present in many tools and services people use daily. Voice assistants like Siri, Alexa, and Google Assistant understand spoken commands and respond with useful information or actions. Chatbots on websites help customers by answering questions, while image recognition systems identify faces, objects, or medical conditions from photos and scans. AI is also used in recommendation systems on platforms like YouTube, Draz, and Amazon to suggest videos or products based on user preferences. In transportation, self-driving cars use AI to interpret their surroundings and make safe driving decisions. These applications make technology more interactive, efficient, and adaptive, offering personalized experiences in almost every digital service today.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The platform is printed as Draz here; it is Daraz, as the book itself writes in the next section.
